sparky

Simple, optional services.

Your Sparky hardware and everything running locally remain yours independently of any subscription.

Human Support and the managed AI service are separate optional subscriptions billed monthly through Stripe. You may subscribe to either, both, or neither. Subscriptions renew until cancelled and can be managed through the Stripe Billing Portal.

Cancelling Support ends the optional human-support service. Cancelling managed AI ends access to Sparky’s hosted model service. Neither cancellation disables your device, local data, or local homelab services.

Buying a Sparky. We dispatch within 14 days of your order, to UK addresses, and will tell you if anything is going to delay that. The buy page states the price you pay, including delivery, before you commit.

Cancelling and returns. You have 14 days from the day your Sparky arrives to change your mind, for any reason, without giving one. Email hello@sparky-box.com and you then have 14 days to send it back. We refund the price you paid, including standard outbound delivery, within 14 days of receiving it back or of proof that you sent it. You pay the cost of returning it, and it should come back in the condition it reached you.

Separately, if a Sparky is faulty, not as described, or not fit for purpose, your rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015 apply — including rejecting it within 30 days for a full refund. Nothing on this page affects those rights.

Services included with a purchase. A purchase may include a period of these services. Where it does, the length is stated at the time of purchase and runs from when your device is set up rather than from when you order it. An included period is not a subscription and does not renew: nothing is charged when it ends, and you are not asked for card details to receive it. We will tell you before it runs out, and what it costs to carry on if you want to.

Fair use of the managed AI. The AI service is subject to fair-use limits, so that one device cannot degrade the service for everyone else. We do not publish a fixed figure: the price and capability of the underlying models change frequently, and the limit moves with them. It is set well above normal household use, and we will give reasonable notice before reducing it. If a device reaches the limit, its AI service pauses until the next day. The device, your local data and your local services are unaffected.

Services are provided with reasonable care, but availability may occasionally be interrupted for maintenance or circumstances outside our control.

Questions can be sent to hello@sparky-box.com.
